researchNotes: Range list from the official Creed UK site's Shopify products.json feed (product type Fragrance; samples, sets, candles, soaps, body care and atomisers skipped). Notes, family and concentration read from each official UK product page (creedfragrances.co.uk); the global site creedfragrance.com was only fetched for its listing page, which showed Eladaria, Absolu Aventus, Aventus, Centaurus, Delphinus, Millesime Imperial, Royal Mayfair, Queen of Silk, Aventus For Her, Royal Oud among 61 products over 3 pages, so some UK-listed fragrances may be discontinued or UK-only on the global site; none marked discontinued as no page says so. Pages state EDP for all, including those named Cologne. Only Aventus page gave a launch year. No perfumers stated. Country left null: sources describe the house variously as London-founded (brand account) and Anglo-French/Paris-based (Wikipedia), so no single country was recorded.

fragrances.name: Aventus
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scento 2026 review: about 6-10 h on skin, newer batches can fade in 3-4 h; the page gives no sillage level, and reviewers say projection is strongest in the first 2-3 h.

fragrances.name: Iris Debonair
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba estimates 6-8 h and a close-to-skin trail, since the iris and fig stay soft. Other reviews range 4-12 h. Sillage is described as moderate, close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Wild Vetiver
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba: 6-8 h, still readable at about 6 h; reviewers report 6-8 h, one 7-8 h. Parfumo users rate sillage solid to elegant, but give no level, so sillage is left null.

fragrances.name: Absolu Aventus
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Most sources give 6-10 h on skin, with a 2025 batch reported at 4-6 h. Sillage is strong early and fades after about 3 h, so set to moderate.

fragrances.name: Spring Flower
fragrances.family: floral fresh, crisp, fruity & soft woods

fragrances.name: Aventus Cologne
fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base: about 3 h on average with intimate projection; other reports 2-6 h, and recent batches are said to be weaker. The 6-10 h figures found appear to describe the EDP, so they were not counted.

fragrances.name: Viking
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reviews of the 2017 EDP mostly give 6-8 h (some 8-10 h, some 5-7 h); sillage described as moderate. Search summary only; some pages mix up the Cologne version.

sources.name: Creed UK — Love in White for Summer

fragrances.name: Aventus For Her

sources.name: Venba — Creed Aventus for Her EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Venba: most wearers get 6-8 h (shorter on dry skin). Venba rates sillage moderate to strong and Fragrance Review says moderate, so set to 3.

fragrances.name: Virgin Island Water

sources.name: Scentgrail — Creed Virgin Island Water review (2024)
The Scent Base — Virgin Island Water

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scent Grail: up to about 5 h at best, with almost no sillage after 30 min; The Scent Base: intimate projection, around 3 h on average. Perfume.com claims 4-6 h, which I did not count as the majority view.

fragrances.name: Love in Black

sources.name: Perfumenez — Creed Love in Black review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com and Perfumenez: about 6-8 h on skin. Perfumenez rates sillage strong, and Scento's aggregate gives strong projection. Vivir's 2024 edition is weaker (4-6 h), noted but not counted as the majority.

fragrances.name: Royal Oud
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Most Parfumo users give 5-8 h (set to 4 for 6-8 h); The Scent Base aggregate says 6+ h with intimate projection, but most reviews call sillage moderate, so set to 3. Venba's 8-10 h is promotional, not counted.

fragrances.name: Original Santal
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Several sellers and reviews give 6-8 h on skin; Scento describes long-lasting wear with moderate projection. Newer batches reportedly last longer. A Scent Base community figure of 3-6 h was not counted.

fragrances.name: Himalaya
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragman review: about 6-8 h depending on skin and weather; FragranceX gives a similar range. Projection is described as modest, moderate for the first 2-3 h, then close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Silver Mountain Water
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Reviews split on longevity (under 2 h to 8-15 h, depending on batch, age and application), so no level is set; sillage is generally described as moderate.

fragrances.name: Millésime Impérial
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Most user reports put it at 4-6 h; a Parfumo reviewer found it gone by about 4 h. Sillage is soft to moderate and fades after 3-4 h. Vivir and vendor pages claim 6-10 h, which I did not count.

fragrances.name: Green Irish Tweed

sources.name: The Scent Base — Green Irish Tweed

fragrances.performanceEvidence: thescentbase aggregate: longevity 6+ h, reviews cluster around 8 h; projection listed as intimate (soft). Basenotes thread is split on longevity.
